detaileddescription.para: Register a component name and return its stable handle.

Registration is idempotent: registering the same name again returns the original handle, and the first registration determines its initial enabled state. Empty names are rejected with std::invalid_argument.
Find a previously registered component without implicitly creating it.
Enable or disable a component by registered name. Returns false if unknown.

memberdef.argsstring: (Component const &comp, Verbosity msg_verbosity, std::string_view fmt_str, Args &&... args)

detaileddescription.para: Log a message formatted via fmt when the component is enabled and the current verbosity is >= msg_verbosity. Prefix includes component, verbosity, and rank (if available).
